constraints.description: SIGTERM and SIGINT begin HTTP drain immediately; the configured timeout is measured from signal observation; graceful and deadline-enforced outcomes are mutually exclusive; held work, stderr lock, and stderr backpressure cannot extend the one-second post-deadline observation bound.

validation.validation_method: Real child-process signal, listener, SSE, held-cleanup, stderr-lock, and stderr-backpressure tests with the baseline behavioral failures retained

constraints.description: The normal path waits for ingestion, A2A, MCP transports, live-query supervisors, and SurrealKV release; MCP cancellation starts concurrently with blocked cleanup; caller-owned HTTP cancellation never becomes process shutdown.

validation.validation_method: Focused MCP/live-query tests plus same-path C-12 process restart and its different-path failing control

constraints.description: A non-root server-full container holding a real SSE request exits 0 at the 30-second internal deadline and before Docker's 35-second stop limit, terminates the request, emits deadline_enforced, and has no SIGKILL event.

validation.validation_method: Release binary in the non-root runtime image, monotonic docker-stop timing, synchronous marker inspection, container exit inspection, and raw Docker event replay

constraints.description: Every bounded or fail-closed shutdown assertion is paired with an observed failing control and exact command/output; the verification table reports server-full only and does not claim the pending parent soak.

validation.validation_method: Verification-row inspection, baseline 6-failure process control, different-path C-12 failure, and immutable-candidate exit-137 receipt

constraints.description: Tier 0, focused tests, strict OpenSpec, shell syntax, scoped diff, dependency diff, and visibility inspection pass; no dependency, public API, protocol, provider, GitHub Actions, push, PR, release, or GA change is introduced.

validation.validation_method: Recorded local gates plus final staged-path and source-receipt audit

global_rules: Treat the child OpenSpec delta, tasks, KBD scope, and outer immutable-candidate rules as acceptance authority.
Run development verification locally; GitHub Actions are deployment-only.
Do not represent the focused container control as the parent 10,800-second certification.
Do not stage unrelated KBD projections, local settings, root refiner state, static assets, or operator changes.

The constraints schema does not enumerate code, so this direct-code refinement uses its schema-valid content discriminator only in constraints.json; state and manifest retain code as the artifact type.
termination_conditions: All five blocking constraints pass with observed local evidence.
State, constraints, manifest, checkpoints, references, active/history identity, strict OpenSpec, and final scope receipts validate deterministically.
The verification artifact states the pending parent certification limit and makes no cross-profile or release verdict.
